name: hcb-dev
description: Personal developer baseline — a connected pipeline from a task or an issue to reviewed, completed work: slicing and building behind one planning gate, local review in one round with every source — Claude's angles, security angles and a Codex pass — its findings checked by an independent verifier and each source's coverage reported, completion by mode (a local merge into the parent, or a change request), the forge's issue tracker and its label set, handing work across sessions, surveying a backlog slice against the code, fanning an epic out to parallel sessions in waves, saying where the work stands in whichever role a session holds, keeping a branch current with a base that moved and reading what it brought, and git cleanup.

batch_model.title: Batch model
batch_model.description: The model a master session starts its batch sessions on, as `claude --model` takes it — an alias or a full model id.

batch_effort.title: Batch effort
batch_effort.description: The effort level a master session starts its batch sessions at.

batch_profiles.title: Batch aimux profiles
batch_profiles.description: The aimux profiles batch sessions may run under, comma-separated. Empty means every Claude profile aimux knows.

batch_ceiling_5h.title: Batch 5-hour ceiling, %
batch_ceiling_5h.description: An aimux profile whose 5-hour window is used at or above this percentage takes no new batch.

batch_ceiling_7d.title: Batch weekly ceiling, %
batch_ceiling_7d.description: An aimux profile whose weekly window is used at or above this percentage takes no new batch.
